original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. actual_scope: State and prove a rank identity for products of rank-one query units and a window bound N - r >= w over an algebra with a bimodule projection (covering the uniform Clifford cosets), and check them exactly on the literal #6726 header and explicit models.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a source-bound construction. This package is a mathematical statement with exact checks on the #6726 header word; it constructs no new word and claims no kappa.

open_questions.question: Does a bound of the same form hold when the ordinary controls do not commute with the body variables, so that setting them to one is not an algebra homomorphism?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Section 5 of PROOF.md excludes such controls; the specialisation to body variables equal to one is used.
open_questions.first_step: Find an algebra containing the monomials and the body variables in which a bimodule projection with E(Q)=0 survives, or an explicit word that beats the window bound.
open_questions.blocked_by: A literal non-commuting control pair from a physical caller.

open_questions.question: Is there a native whose per-port central part is not a square-zero unit and that saves contact without losing the window?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Lemma 3 needs zero self-pairing; a non-square-zero central action is outside the statement.
open_questions.first_step: Write the per-port central word as units with v_i u_i != 0 and compute rank(I+FG) in the Setting.
open_questions.blocked_by: A literal native word with such a central part.

open_questions.question: What bound holds when query units are supplied by a recursive job of the same kind?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The count N counts the units of one flat word; a recursive supply interface is not a flat word.
open_questions.first_step: Define the interface of a job whose outputs are query units and state its unit count in the Setting.
open_questions.blocked_by: A compiler-level definition of the interface.
